title: 2017 year-end summary
summary: In 2017, I experienced too many ups and downs. Facing overwhelming blows and disappointment from the beginning, I gradually turned setbacks into a habit. It can be said that I was fighting against myself this year.
markdown:
2017 was a year filled with many setbacks and difficulties for me. Facing a series of blows, I felt disappointed at first, but gradually learned to face setbacks as a habit. Although I have not completely gotten over the shadow left by the setback, I firmly believe that one day the sun will shine and spring will come as promised!
Looking back on 2017, I did the following for myself:
1. Created my own blog: By writing a blog, I can share my learning and experience with others, while also consolidating my own theoretical knowledge.
1. In-depth study of core JavaScript knowledge: I understand that in the field of programming, it is very important to master core technologies. Therefore, I spent a lot of time learning the core concepts and technologies of JavaScript in depth to improve my programming skills.
1. Learn the technologies related to the Internet of Things: The Internet of Things is the future trend. I realize its importance and invest time and energy to learn the technologies related to it. This gave me a deeper understanding of IoT and prepared me for future developments.
1. Keep using the Hearing app: I found that through the Hearing app, I can access a variety of content related to my major, which greatly improved my cognition and learning efficiency.
Looking forward to 2018, I have set the following small goals for myself:
1. Continue to learn the core JavaScript technology in depth: I realize that core knowledge of the programming language is crucial to my career development. Therefore, I will continue to study the core concepts and technologies of JavaScript in depth and continuously improve my programming abilities.
1. Consolidate theoretical knowledge in the form of sharing technology: By writing blogs and participating in technical forums, I will share the knowledge and experience I have learned with others. This not only consolidates my theoretical knowledge, but also helps others solve problems and promote mutual growth.
1. Overcoming English difficulties: English has always been a difficulty for me, but I am determined to keep translating English materials every day, even if it is just one sentence. By studying persistently, I believe my English ability will improve.
1. Participate in open source projects and improve yourself: Participating in open source projects is a good opportunity to exercise my programming skills and teamwork skills. I plan to actively participate in open source projects and continue to improve my technical skills by collaborating with other outstanding developers.
2018 will be a year full of opportunities and challenges for me. I believe that through continuous learning and hard work, I can continue to grow and move towards the road of success. Let us look forward to a better future together!
